newsOverlay.marketBias: Saudi supply risk has re-intensified after earlier easing: Reuters reports more East-West Pipeline damage than initially known, cancelled crude shipments and halted Yanbu loadings. BOJ tightening, a strong dollar and possible yen intervention remain global-liquidity volatility risks. WATCH only; no buy or sell signal is created.

items.headline: Saudi supply concerns re-intensify as pipeline damage proves broader
items.summary: Reuters reports three Saudi East-West Pipeline pumping stations were damaged, more than initially reported, with no clear repair timeline; Saudi Aramco cancelled crude shipments to at least two European refiners and halted Yanbu loadings. Oil pared earlier losses as Saudi-Houthi tensions and constrained regional shipping kept supply risk elevated.
items.whyItMatters: Renewed energy-supply risk can lift inflation expectations and yields, tighten financial conditions and pressure risk-asset liquidity, reversing part of the earlier oil-relief narrative.
items.actionReason: Material reversal in the Saudi supply-risk assessment, but it does not independently trigger a Crypto Reca entry or exit.

items.headline: Yen slumps after BOJ hike underwhelms; intervention risk returns
items.summary: Reuters reports USD/JPY rose more than 1.2% to about 158.07 after the BOJ raised rates to 1.25%, as markets judged forward guidance insufficiently hawkish. Japan's finance minister signaled possible intervention concern, adding two-way FX volatility risk.
items.whyItMatters: A sharp yen move can alter carry-trade positioning, global yields and risk-asset liquidity; intervention risk can amplify cross-asset volatility.
items.actionReason: Material post-BOJ market reaction and intervention risk, but no direct Crypto Reca entry or exit instruction.

items.headline: Oil falls for third session as Saudi supply-disruption fears ease
items.summary: Reuters reports oil extended declines as Saudi rerouting and restoration efforts reduced immediate supply fears, easing part of the inflation shock while geopolitical risks remain.
items.whyItMatters: Energy prices transmit into inflation expectations, yields and risk-asset liquidity.
items.actionReason: Earlier easing assessment has been superseded by renewed Saudi pipeline and shipment concerns.

items.headline: Ueda gives cautious guidance after BOJ hike
items.summary: Reuters reports Ueda stressed data-dependent policy without strong guidance on the timing of another hike.
items.whyItMatters: Immediate scheduled BOJ communication risk passed without a clearly more-hawkish surprise.
items.actionReason: Resolved event risk; no independent buy or sell instruction.

items.headline: BOJ raises policy rate to 1.25%, 31-year high
items.summary: Reuters confirms the BOJ raised its policy rate from 1.00% to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote.
items.whyItMatters: Japanese tightening can affect yen carry trades, global yields and risk-asset liquidity.
items.actionReason: Decision resolved; no independent buy or sell instruction.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs shifts to October Fed hike call
items.summary: Reuters reports Goldman Sachs expects another 25 bp Fed hike in October after the September increase.
items.whyItMatters: A higher expected Fed path can pressure risk-asset liquidity and crypto valuations.
items.actionReason: Macro repricing is context, not an independent sell instruction.

items.headline: SEC grants five-year conditional exemption for tokenized U.S. stock trading
items.summary: Reuters reports the SEC introduced a five-year exemption allowing qualifying platforms to trade tokenized stocks with full shareholder rights while excluding synthetic derivative tokens.
items.whyItMatters: The exemption expands regulated U.S. use of blockchain market infrastructure.
items.actionReason: Positive regulatory news never creates a buy signal.

items.headline: Warsh says inflation remains too high
items.summary: Reuters reports Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high and persistent.
items.whyItMatters: Hawkish guidance supports further tightening risk.
items.actionReason: Context only, not an independent sell instruction.

items.headline: Federal Reserve raises target rate 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%
items.summary: Reuters confirms the Federal Reserve raised its key interest rate by 25 basis points and indicated more tightening is likely.
items.whyItMatters: Renewed Fed tightening can lift real yields and reduce risk-asset liquidity.
items.actionReason: Further tightening remains possible; not an independent sell instruction.
